title: Door Slam
blurb: A heavy door slammed hard, and the full stop of sound effects. Nothing else ends a scene so decisively: an argument, an exit, a flat refusal to continue the conversation. Sitcoms have used it as a punchline for decades. Horror uses it to tell you that something is now in the room with you, or alternatively that you are now completely alone. Play it when you want the last word without having to say anything at all.
origin: A recording of a heavy door being slammed shut.
